dedupe_keys.name: combined effect of temperature and humidity on distorted currents measured by rogowski coils

description: Costa, Federica and colleagues publish this resource through the source community. Three commercial Rogowski coils measure distorted currents while temperature and humidity change together. Coverage is the source-defined current-sensor calibration experiment, comparing total harmonic distortion with individual harmonic measurements. The study reports limited change in overall THD but stronger effects on individual harmonics, with different behaviour among the devices. The broad IT4PQ archive includes a Bologna temperature/humidity component; exact sample overlap with this paper is not established. These tests do not imply that standards already incorporated the recommended changes. Zenodo supplies the descriptive publication with open access under cc-by-4.0. The publication does not establish public access to an implementation or its separate licence. A limitation is that complete implementation or measurement settings cannot be reconstructed from descriptive metadata alone. Related experimental components and publications retain their distinct roles; separate deposits are not assumed to provide independent observations. The experiment assesses power quality measurement under combined environmental conditions.
